news.title: PS5 26.06-14.10.00 Released Oct 1 2026 - Do NOT Update
news.body: Sony pushed PS5 26.06-14.10.00 on Oct 1 2026 with security fixes. It patches UMTX/etaHEN chains. Stay on 7.61 or lower for stable jailbreak, newer 8.xx-10.xx only partial toolbox/cheats support.

news.title: PS4 14.00 Released Sept 16 2026 - Do NOT Update
news.body: PS4 14.00 is out since Sept 16 2026 and patches the 13.52 chain. If you want homebrew, stay on 13.52 or lower. Updating kills GoldHEN.

news.title: PS4 13.52 Is Latest Exploitable (Sept 2026)
news.body: As of Sept 20 2026 ConsoleMods lists 13.52 as latest publicly exploitable PS4 firmware with GoldHEN. 14.00 is patched. Stay on 13.52 or lower, disable auto-updates.

news.title: etaHEN 2.5B: Full Support to 8.20, Partial to 10.01
news.body: etaHEN 2.5B adds full 8.00/8.20 kstuff support, toolbox/cheats for 8.40-10.01. UMTX chain stays most stable on 7.61 and below. Higher than 10.01: no public jailbreak.

news.title: PS4 11.00 PPPwn Jailbreak Available
news.body: PPPwn exploit by TheOfficialFloW supports PS4 on firmware 11.00 and below. Run GoldHEN after exploit for homebrew. Stay on 11.00 or lower, do NOT update if you want homebrew.

news.title: PS5 UMTX Stable up to 7.61
news.body: UMTX kernel exploit chain is most stable up to PS5 7.61 with ItemzFlow / etaHEN. Newer firmwares have only partial support. Do not update past 7.61 for full jailbreak.
